items.title: The plan prompt names the current schema
checks: Guide, COPY PLAN PROMPT, paste it anywhere: the prose and the JSON skeleton name the same schema version.

items.title: Rep count is called at lockout
items.intro: Any working set of a barbell lift with both sensors on the bar.
checks: Each rep is called ("rep 3") as the bar reaches the top, not on the way down.
"Last rep" is called going into the final planned rep.
After the set, export the session's Raw zip and send it in chat.

items.title: Both units on one weight stack
items.intro: An extra set, only if a stack machine is free.
checks: Clip unit A and unit B to the same stack; the SETUP card shows both as connected before START SET.
The set records reps from both units; History shows the set.

items.title: Older Android versions
checks: Needs a phone on Android 8-11: the app installs and scans.
